chapters.title: What Oneness Actually Means
editorial_queries: In the ten stations of *Jaddiyyat*, the clause "the seventh standing lower and the higher being something other than it" is obscure — the intended distinction between the seventh degree and the higher ones is not clear.
comprehension_flags: The dense run of station-names (*Hijabiyyat*, *Hujjiyyat*, *Jaddiyyat*) and rank-degrees (*Mumin*, *Mukathir*, *Madhun*) arrives without definition, and a general reader may lose the thread of the hierarchy without a glossary this pass is not authorized to add.
terminology_notes: ibda al-zawat / ibda-e zawat — the same concept (origination of beings) appears in two spellings within a few lines; one form should be standardized book-wide.
